name: Hochiki Corporation
summary: Hochiki Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, consulting, engineering, design, and maintenance of fire alarm systems, fire extinguishing, crime prevention systems, and network and security systems. The company's fire alarm systems comprise automatic fire alarm systems, emergency alarm systems, fire reporting devices, fixed water sprinkler systems, apartment house automatic fire alarm systems, high sensitivity aspirating smoke detection systems, smoke control systems, and residential use smoke alarms.
